arxiv-2309-13572.title: Causal Asymmetry of Classical and Quantum Autonomous Agents
arxiv-2309-13572.creator: Spiros Kechrimparis, Mile Gu, Hyukjoon Kwon
arxiv-2309-13572.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Spiros Kechrimparis, Mile Gu, Hyukjoon Kwon. Why is it that a ticking clock typically becomes less accurate when subject to outside noise but rarely the reverse? Here, we formalize this phenomenon by introducing process causal asymmetry – a fundamental difference in the amount of past information an autonomous agent must track to transform one stochastic process to another over an agent that transforms in the opposite direction. We then illustrate that this asymmetry can paradoxically be reversed when agents possess a quantum memory.

arxiv-2504-04395.title: Human-Level Competitive Pokémon via Scalable Offline Reinforcement Learning with Transformers
arxiv-2504-04395.creator: Jake Grigsby, Yuqi Xie †, Justin Sasek †, Steven Zheng †, Yuke Zhu
arxiv-2504-04395.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Jake Grigsby, Yuqi Xie †, Justin Sasek †, Steven Zheng †, Yuke Zhu. Competitive Pokémon Singles (CPS) is a popular strategy game where players learn to exploit their opponent based on imperfect information in battles that can last more than one hundred stochastic turns. AI research in CPS has been led by heuristic tree search and online self-play, but the game may also create a platform to study adaptive policies trained offline on large datasets.

pmc-11311312.description: Torilis japonica (TJ) fruit, is a herb that is traditionally used for erectile dysfunction (ED).
